name: medium-research-stackexchange
description: Stack Exchange research with normalized MCP output. Wraps Stack Exchange API 2.3 network-wide (so_hot_questions, so_search, so_get_question) — the `site` param defaults to "stackoverflow" and accepts any SE network site string. Runs fully keyless; an optional STACKEXCHANGE_KEY raises the daily API quota and is injected via the sensitive user_config field below (stored in the OS keychain, masked on input, never written to disk in plaintext). Actual .mcpb packing is deferred to v2 (PKG-01); this manifest is documentation/scaffold only.

stackexchange_key.title: Stack Exchange API key
stackexchange_key.description: Optional — raises the daily Stack Exchange API quota. The server runs keyless without it. Register an app at https://stackapps.com/apps/oauth/register to obtain a 'key'.
